newsitem.title: USA: Ga. governor to recommend $31 mln in harbor bonds.
newsitem.headline: Ga. governor to recommend $31 mln in harbor bonds.

text.p: Georgia Gov. Zell Miller said Friday he would recommend making $31 million in improvements to the Savannah harbor system and terminals in his proposed 1998 fiscal year state budget.
In a statement, Miller said that the general obligation bonds would be used for the following:
-- $3.2 million for dike construction and harbor maintenance at the Savannah Harbor Navigation Channel.
-- $8.7 million to extend berth 13 by construction of a 700 foot dock.
-- $5.8 million to build a 20,000 square foot transit shed for bulk cargo.
-- $13.3 million to buy two container cranes.
"Our exports are growing at better than 20 percent a year, and the principal reason is our first-class ports in Savannah and Brunswick," Miller said.
